request: PUMCH is an in-house Mandarin Chinese speech dataset for cleft-palate speech assessment, comprising recordings from 244 participants, including 128 patients with cleft palate and 116 healthy controls. Keep the spoken content and evaluate all methods to summarize what works for this task.

Formant_lpc, formant_spec, and pitch often retain the subtle acoustic cues required for clinical or cognitive assessment better than Resyn or NeuralVC.
